title: Prism Breaker
tagline: Shatter glass and neon into refracting shards — then bend light itself around a black hole.
description: A 3D brick breaker with glass and neon bricks that burst into iridescent shards. Thirty hand-made levels across Crystal Caverns, Neon City and the Solar Core, each world ending in a Prism Core boss that dodges, fires orbs and raises shields. Catch Multi-ball, Laser, Wide and Slow power-ups, chain crystal charges into explosions and keep combos alive for climbing chimes. Gravity Well is the creative mode: an endless field where a movable black hole curves every shot and slingshots the ball through a wormhole.
controls: Drag / move the mouse to steer the paddle · tap, click or Space to launch · ←/→ or A/D · Esc/P pause
fablePass: Music: synthwave bed per world, boss theme with intensity layers tied to core HP
Boss: animated core phases (shield unfolding, charge-up tell before orb volleys)
Paddle: squash/stretch + thruster flare when moving fast
Finale: the three cores reassemble into a rotating prism; camera pull-back
Gravity Well: lensing distortion of the starfield around the horizon
